A feeling that is not your own is being pressed into you as you read this.

You notice something being done to you: a feeling is being forced in from outside.
A current of sensation is running through you, and it is coming from someone else.
Someone is sending a feeling into you, steadily, and it has not stopped.
There is a pressure inside you right now that was put there from outside.
A sensation is being piped into you, and you did not ask for it.
Something outside you is changing how you feel, right now, as you read.
